mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID : 임시 로그인*/ A.ACCOUNT_ID /*계정ID */ ,A.INSTITUTION_CODE /*기관코드 */ ,(SELECT INSTITUTION_NAME FROM USCM.TBCM_INST_M WHERE A.INSTITUTION_CODE = INSTITUTION_CODE) AS INSTITUTION_NM ,A.DEPT_ID /*부서ID */ ,A.GRADE_CODE /*직급코드 */ ,A.GRADE_NAME /*직급명 */ ,A.USER_NAME /*사용자명 */ ,A.USER_ID /*사용자ID */ ,A.UNITY_ID /*통합ID */ ,A.EMAIL /*이메일 */ ,A.DEPT_NAME /*부서명 */ ,A.POSITION_CODE /*직위코드 */ ,A.POSITION_NAME /*직위명 */ ,A.POSITION_DETAIL /*직위상세 */ ,A.DUTY_CODE /*직책명 */ ,A.PHOTO_PATH /*사진경로 */ ,A.MOBILE_NUMBER /*이동전화번호 */ ,A.OFFICE_NUMBER /*사무실전화번호 */ ,A.OFFICE_FAX_NUMBER /*사무실FAX번호 */ ,A.OFFICE_ZIPCODE /*사무실우편번호 */ ,A.OFFICE_ADRES /*사무실주소 */ ,A.OFFICE_DETAIL_ADRES /*사무실상세주소 */ ,A.HOMEPAGE /*홈페이지 */ ,A.CONCURRENT_TYPE /*겸직유형 */ ,A.DISPATCH_TYPE /*파견유형 */ ,A.MNTNAB_TYPE /*존폐유형 */ ,A.USER_TYPE /*사용자유형 */ ,A.CONFM_TYPE /*확정유형 */ ,A.PKI_DN /*PKIDN값 */ ,A.BIRTH_DATE /*생년월일 */ ,A.ON_ID /*온나라아이디 */ ,A.USER_CHARGE /*담당직무 */ ,A.EUM_ID /*나라이음아이디 */ ,A.USER_ORDER /*사용자정렬순서 */ ,A.IOP_ID /*지능형ID */ ,A.UPDATE_TIME /*수정일시 */ ,A.CATALOG_AUTHRT_CD /*카탈로그권한코드 */ ,USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(A.CATALOG_AUTHRT_CD) AS CATALOG_AUTHRT_NM /*카탈로그권한명 */ FROM USCM.TBCM_USER_M_TEMP A WHERE 1=1 AND CATALOG_AUTHRT_CD IS NOT NULL ORDER BY A.CATALOG_AUTHRT_CD ,A.INSTITUTION_CODE
